A smooth gentle backward camera track from the same front-left viewpoint keeps her entire silver gown, hat and feet in frame; nearby table edges move in parallax while the distant room remains stable. The woman is poised, confident and quietly glamorous, looking slightly toward the tables on screen-left. Her hips advance with each step, the hem and pale pink wrap follow with weight and small delayed motion. The gentleman follows half a step behind her and takes real steps, not a frozen pose. Background diners remain discreetly alive. In the final two seconds she eases to a natural stop beside the near table, shifts her gaze slightly toward it and begins a small shoulder turn toward screen-left; her hands remain low. This final movement is the outgoing action for the next table-side shot. Her pale wrap stays OVER BOTH SHOULDERS throughout this entrance: no removing or putting on clothing in this shot. Keep exact identity, tilted decorated hat, anatomical right-chest rose (viewer left), fitted silver gown, quiet confidence, warm restaurant and oil-painted strokes. Silver highlights belong to folds, not uniform glitter or mesh. Do not zoom instead of moving the camera; no face changes, sudden lens change, extra limbs, foot skating, huge strides, exaggerated swaying, slow-motion freeze, low head, raised hand, new people, cuts, or scene transformation. Deliver graceful lived movement rather than an animated still.
